items.heading: Dialysis transport
steps: Call Lakeshore Community Health Plan number on plan card to schedule rides.
Ask dialysis unit for earlier chair time to reduce travel burden and exhaustion.
Message DaVita Park Manor dialysis unit social worker for transport assistance and benefits coordination.

items.heading: Kidney diet food help
steps: Go to Manna Food Pantry on Mondays 1:00-3:00 PM at 1230 S Millard Ave (1.56 miles away).
Ask DaVita Park Manor dietitian to adapt renal diet around accessible corner store foods.
Go to Greater Garfield MB Church pantry on Fridays 10:00 AM-12:00 PM at 3757 W Douglas Blvd (1.71 miles away).

items.heading: Weight and blood pressure log
steps: Keep doing a daily weight and blood pressure log on paper; bring it to each session.

closing: Contact your care team if you have questions.
